## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION signalling CREDIT STRESS ↑ are offset by reflation via CPER (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, producing mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION indicate HYG/LQD moving to tighter conditions (CREDIT STRESS ↑). Reflation and commodity strength: CPER (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and XLE (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND driving sector breadth.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength recovering: UUP proxy (1W: +1.09% | 1M: -0.55%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Stocks vs bonds mixed: SPY (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%) CORRECTION — SPY/TLT is flat → CORRECTION.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/value leading: XLE (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND and Materials XME (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +15.86%) CORRECTION showing strength while Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION. Europe showing relative resilience: VGK proxy (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +2.83%) ABOVE TREND, while China weak: FXI (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -2.76%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: IBIT (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -15.00%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%) BELOW TREND. Small cap resilience remains: IWM (1W: -0.74% | 1M: +5.63%) CORRECTION.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation intact: CPER (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and broad commodity proxies GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%) CORRECTION showing 1W profit-taking versus strong 1M gains. Industrial inputs and materials breadth support reflation.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND with BNO/USO also ABOVE TREND (BNO 1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%; USO 1W: +2.39% | 1M: +12.34%). Natural gas volatile: UNG (1W: -11.70% | 1M: +7.63%) CORRECTION.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE and CPER both timeframes positive supporting reflation. MAJOR DIVERGENCE: SPY (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION, XLF (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -2.55%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%) CORRECTION — 1W ≠ 1M across core ETFs indicates a transitional market and suppresses a strong directional call.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity-exposed ETFs: XLE (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +15.86%) CORRECTION showing strength; reduce exposure to large-cap tech: XLK (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND and crypto/innovation ETFs IBIT (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -15.00%) BELOW TREND. Bonds neutral given mixed SPY/TLT signals.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND if energy prices hold and XME (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +15.86%) CORRECTION on industrial demand signs. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND and Technology/semis ETFs like QQQ (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +0.55%) CORRECTION if momentum fails to re-accelerate.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%) ABOVE TREND for reflation continuation. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%) CORRECTION on short-term profit-taking and SLV (1W: -24.24% | 1M: +17.05%) CORRECTION for volatility risk.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (VXX 1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%) ABOVE TREND marks complacency vs fear threshold; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (HYG 1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION signals credit stress; XLK/XLF ratio ~2.65 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -5.75% | 1M: +3.02%) CORRECTION is the growth/value pivot to watch.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from rising VXX and rising CPER with HYG/LQD showing credit stress ↑. Energy and materials showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, CPER ABOVE TREND) while tech and speculative ETFs (XLK, IBIT) are showing weakness and warrant monitoring for further divergence.
